title: Kids Planner - Printable & Editable PDF
author: Creative Art Tribe
description:
Cute Kids Bullet Journal PDF, Kids Planner PDF, Planner Kit for Kids, Colorful Planner Kit
With this planner, your child will better organize, feel responsible, be creative, feel gratitude, free emotions using a daily journal, track weekly good habits, plan a birthday party, learn to love himself, have a reading list, etc.
WHAT’S INCLUDED:
1 non editable – PRINTABLE PDF – 18 pages.
->Print it at home, or at a local printing shop/ online printing shop.
->The pages are undated – you can print as many times as you want.
->If you want to print only one of the pages, simply choose the page from the printing settings before pressing the Print Button.
1 editable in Canva PDF template – keep in mind, this planner includes PRO ELEMENTS/GRAPHICS which means you’ll be able to edit elements only if you have a pro account. -> If you don’t have a pro account, you can change the pro elements with free CANVA elements – only then you’ll be able to download.
PLEASE NOTE:
-> The colors sometimes vary on the computer monitors and may differ from the printed versions.
